title: GibasWelcomeMessage
description: A customizable plugin for Minecraft Paper 1.21+ servers with welcome messages, configurable sounds, and support for cores and dynamic variables.
body:
# How to use it:

- <message> --> just the normal chat message ( 100 blocks radius )
- /g <message> --> sends a global message
- /tell <player> <message> --> sends a private message to the designated player
- /r <message> --> answers a private message with ease
